item.title: About
item.description:
I am a self-directed and driven Application Security Engineer with a keen interest in understanding the fundamentals of everything from how AI (really LLMs… ) works to how Potatoes work for fun and profit.

With my research and career experience I work towards securing enterprise systems and driving new innovation in the field of Cyber Security. In my free time I like reading up about how compilers work, how new CVEs are exploited or playing around with any CTF challenge that catches my eye.
